lines.trans: I saw bandits carry away our teacher.
We need to urgently do something about this.
It is unpleasant when they stare at us like that.
Calm down, I will speak with their head chef.
We will calmly find out everything here right now.

examples.text: Мне надо спокойно разобраться в себе.
examples.trans: I need to calmly figure myself out.

examples.text: Тебе нужно выбрать между двумя парнями.
examples.trans: You need to choose between two guys.

examples.text: Давайте лучше пойдём обратно на кухню.
examples.trans: Let us better go back to the kitchen.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: А ну быстро пошёл вон отсюда!
examples.trans: Get out of here right now!

examples.text: Быстро уберите её во двор, глупцы!
examples.trans: Quickly take her out to the courtyard, fools!

examples.text: Ешьте быстрее, пока всё не остыло.
examples.trans: Eat faster before everything gets cold.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'щищаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'defend yourselves'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и защищаться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and defend yourselves on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют защищаться.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to defend yourselves.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'from', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Давай запустим оттуда красивый свадебный салют.
examples.trans: Let us launch a beautiful wedding fireworks display from there.

examples.text: А ну быстро пошёл вон отсюда!
examples.trans: Get out of here right now!

examples.text: Вы не могли бы приготовить говядину?
examples.trans: Could you please cook this beef?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'these', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Интересно, это японцы или китайцы?
examples.trans: I wonder, are they Japanese or Chinese?

examples.text: Подожди, это наш гость из Кореи.
examples.trans: Wait, this is our guest from Korea.

examples.text: Это же гости приехали из Кореи.
examples.trans: These guests came from Korea after all.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'cooks' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Ага, так я тебе и поверил.
examples.trans: Yeah right, as if I believed you.

examples.text: Нам ещё повезло, если это телятина.
examples.trans: We are lucky if this is veal.

examples.text: Успокойтесь, я поговорю с их шеф-поваром.
examples.trans: Calm down, I will speak with their head chef.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.text: Подожди, я сейчас.
examples.trans: Wait, I'll be right there.

examples.text: Подождите минуту.
examples.trans: Wait a minute.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'nobody', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ты согласилась выйти замуж за Никиту?
examples.trans: Did you agree to marry Nikita?

examples.text: Я обычно никогда так не плачу.
examples.trans: I usually never cry like that.

examples.text: Ты никогда не была на крыше?
examples.trans: Have you never been on the roof?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'not', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ты что, совсем их не различаешь?
examples.trans: Can you really not tell them apart at all?

examples.text: Конечно, я их очень хорошо различаю.
examples.trans: Of course, I tell them apart very well.

examples.text: Мне надо спокойно разобраться в себе.
examples.trans: I need to calmly figure myself out.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'touched', paired with 'тронуть'.

examples.text: Подождите, никто здесь никого не трогал!
examples.trans: Wait, nobody touched anyone in here!

examples.text: Не трогай меня!
examples.trans: Don't touch me!

examples.text: Не трогайте машину.
examples.trans: Don't touch the car.
